summary: Bitzero Holdings filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing a project development agreement with Skanska for its flagship Norway data center, alongside existing partner Vertiv. No financial terms, stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, or advisor were disclosed; closing is not framed as a transaction date. The release is a routine commercial/construction contract announcement covering engineering, procurement, construction, and systems integration through operational readiness. Watch for subsequent procurement, leasing, and tenant-readiness updates, but no deal terms or special-situation mechanics are present.
